text.body:
namo buddhāya ||
bhagavan
yatra yatropapadye 'haṃ karmabhir bhavasaṅkaṭe |
tatra tatra pumān bhūyāṃ śrāddhaś cāvikalendriyaḥ || 1
sarvaśilpakalābhijñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ |
sarvavastuparityāgī sarvakāmaparāṅmukhaḥ || 2
smṛtimān avisaṃvādī sattvānāṃ priyadarśanaḥ |
kalyāṇamitrasaṃsevī bodhicittavibhūṣitaḥ || 3
vinayācārasaṃpannaḥ śucir jātismaraḥ sudhīḥ |
pāpakarmakriyābhīruḥ kalyāṇācāragocaraḥ || 4
% vel: kalyāṇāśayagocaraḥ
ante cānuttarajñānadaśapāramitāśrayām |
% vel: ante cānuttarāṃ bodhiṃ
prāpnuyām acalāṃ nātha jagadekāntasaukhyadām || 5
mā me strītvaṃ mā ca me dāsabhāvo
mā mūrkhatvaṃ mā kudeśeṣu janma |
mithyādṛṣṭir mā kadācin na nīco
buddhotpādo mā ca me bhūt parokṣaḥ || 6
mā tac chīlaṃ yan na buddhatvahetor
mā tad dravyaṃ yat pareṣām abhogyam |
% vel: vittaṃ
kāmaṃ bhikṣāṃ dehi dehīty adeyaṃ
mā me bhogāḥ sattvapīḍākarāḥ syuḥ || 7
jātasya jāyamānasya garbhasthasyāpi dehinaḥ |
mā me tatra kule janma yatra buddho na devatā || 8
pañca dharmān na muñceyaṃ mama janmasu janmasu |
puṇyaṃ jñānaṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ bodhicittaṃ ca pañcamam || 9
yenopāyena sārvajñaṃ prāptaṃ nātha padaṃ tvayā |
tenāha apy upāyena maunīndraṃ padam āpnuyām || 10
+ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
+ + + + + + bhūyo bhūyo bhūyo 'pi bhūyasī || 1o bis?
% Chin?
buddhe bhaktiḥ prakṛtir aśaṭhā sarvasattveṣu maitrī
tyāge 'bhyāsaḥ phalavimukhatā saṃgamo bodhisattvaiḥ |
% vel: prakṛtir acalā sarvasattvānukampī
% vel: satatakaruṇā saṃgamo
prajñā tīkṣṇā sumahati kule janma kāntaṃ vapur me
jātau jātau sugatakavitā cāstv alaṃ vistareṇa || 11
% vel: cāturī vistareṇa
dīrghāyuḥ kulajaḥ pumān paṭumatir vidvān ahīnendriyas
tvadbhaktipravaṇaḥ sukhī sakaruṇaḥ prāsādikaḥ satkaviḥ |
mātṛjñaḥ pitṛbhaktir eva satataṃ jātismaraḥ śīlavān
dharmātmā dhanavān pradānanirataḥ kalyāṇamitrānvitaḥ || 12
utsāhī balavān priyo bahumataḥ sarvāmayair varjitaḥ
sattvānām anukampakaḥ śrutidharaḥ śuddhāśayaḥ kṣāntimān |
% vel: sarvāpadair varjitaḥ
% vel: kṣāntivān
yāval lokahitodayāya bhagavann āpnomi bauddhaṃ padaṃ
tāvat syām aham ebhir eva satataṃ sarvair guṇair bhūṣitaḥ || 13
Candragomipraṇidhānaṃ samāptam || o ||
% instead of col., new ms. reads
oṃ
dānāt pramudito yogī śīlena vimalo bhavet |
kṣāntyā prabhākaro vīryād arciṣmān puṇyavān asau || 14
dhyānād abhimukhotkṛṣṭaḥ prajñayā ca sudurjayaḥ |
duraṅgamo mahopāyo balavān acalo bhavet || 15
sādhuḥ syāt praṇidhānena dharmameghas tu jñānavān |
jinas tathāgataḥ pratyātmavedya ekādaśo bhavet || 16
śubham astu ||
% cf. D1395
